steps.description: The mixture was degassed by placing the flask under vacuum for 20 min.
The reaction flask was placed under N2 and heated to 280 °C with a heating mantle until the solution became clear.
Se powder was added under a N2 stream.
40 mL of toluene was added to the reaction flask to quench nanocrystal growth.
5 mL of acetone was added to every 7.5 mL of reaction solution.
The test tubes were centrifuged to produce a white pellet and an orange supernatant.
Methanol was added to achieve a 1:1 ratio of methanol to QD supernatant.
The solution separated into a thick orange oil and a clear supernatant.
Toluene was added to each test tube to redisperse the oil.
Methanol was added to precipitate the QDs.
The solution was centrifuged and the supernatant was discarded.
The QDs were redispersed in DCM.
Ethanol was added to flocculate the QDs.
The solution was centrifuged and the supernatant was discarded.
Acetone was added to the QD pellet and the tube sonicated until the pellet was dispersed.
The solution was centrifuged and the acetone decanted.
The final sample was dried to yield a fine powder.
